title: Chapter 23
text:
As the parts were quickly polished by various equipment, assembled, and welded together, everyone could see that this was the prototype of a prosthetic limb. What was even more surprising was that Han Xiao did not create any extra parts from the beginning to the end. He did not waste any time, which proved that he really came up with a draft within two minutes.

"Oh my god, is he really going to make it?" Old Man Lu murmured. Lu Qian glared at him. Grandpa was up to no good!

Noticing everyone's surprise, Han Xiao almost laughed out loud. The blueprints were ready-made. Even if he wanted to lose, it would be a piece of cake.

You have created [Bionic Prosthetic Left Arm (Mechanical Type)] and gained 2,000 EXP.

It took Han Xiao two hours and thirty-three minutes to create a metallic prosthetic skeleton.

Everyone in the room was an expert. The shape of the prosthetic skeleton was very suitable for human dynamics. It was powered by sophisticated parts, chains, and a large battery. It looked brand new.

Everyone was shocked.

It was really done!

Lu Qian covered her mouth as her eyes flashed with disbelief. A thought surfaced in her mind.

"What a treasure!"

"As long as you cover the skeleton with a layer of silicone skin, it will look real," Han Xiao explained.

"Stop talking nonsense. Just try it." Old Man Lu swallowed his saliva. Although Han Xiao had indeed surprised him, the initiative was still in the hands of his old friend. He was confident that he could chase Han Xiao away.

The tall old man had no choice but to pick up the artificial limb and take a look at it. He immediately fell in love with it. As soon as he connected the broken limb, he realized that it was very soft to the touch. It was not like other artificial limbs that were rubbing against his skin like a sponge, but it was very tight. The tall old man did not want to wear artificial limbs in the past because they hindered his movement. However, the artificial limb that Han Xiao made did not have this limitation at all. It even gave him the illusion that his arm was still there when he moved it. With the support of the cable, he could use the artificial limb to perform simple arm movements without any effort.

Perfect!

That was the only word that could express how Old Man Gao felt at the moment.

"What do you think? Will this work?"

Old Man Lu calmly drank his wine. Everything was under his control. It was time for him to show off his skills.

Lu Qian looked at the tall old man nervously. She was afraid that he would say no.

The tall old man was in a dilemma.

On one hand, it was a friend's request, and on the other hand, it was his personal feelings. Which was more important?

There was no need to consider this question at all.

"This thing is not bad. I'm very satisfied!"

Old Man Lu spat out a mouthful of wine. He choked and coughed as he glared at Manager Gao.

What happened to being teammates?! You're not playing by the rules!

"If you like it, I'll give it to you." Han Xiao was not surprised at all.

The tall old man nodded. "I'll remember this favor."

Old Man Lu was stunned. Weren't these materials from my family? If you want to talk about favors, it should be my favor! Have you asked me for permission to present you with borrowed flowers?

"Does that mean I can stay?" Han Xiao smiled faintly.

Old Man Lu's face alternated between green and red. He could only pinch his nose and admit defeat. He turned around and went upstairs. Out of sight, out of mind, and out of mind, he left behind an indignant sentence. "Hmph, if you want to stay, then stay. I'll see how long you can stay."

Lu Qian was excited. She waved her little fist in the air.

The tall old man smiled at Han Xiao, waved his hand, and left. He walked out of the alley and got into a black bulletproof car that had been waiting for him for a long time.

The driver respectfully handed over an encrypted phone. The tall old man dialed a number. His aura changed completely. He was a completely different person from the calm old man from before. He said in a deep voice.

"The Germinal Organization has placed a bounty on Zero's head. His coordinates are … Tell the intelligence department to keep a close eye on him. I've had brief contact with the target. I suggest you test him gently. Unless absolutely necessary, do not use force."

Traitors of the Germinal Organization had always been highly sought after by the Six Nations in order to obtain information about the organization. Unfortunately, the traitors in the past were all small fries, and Han Xiao was the only traitor that the Germinal Organization had put a bounty on. Perhaps Han Xiao held some very important information. Therefore, the tall old man decided to test him carefully.

…

Han Xiao retracted his gaze.

His performance should have made the tall old man feel that he was not a threat. It was a good foundation for them to interact.

There were three benefits to coming to the repair shop. First, Old Man Lu had a complete collection of Mechanic class knowledge, which saved him the time of searching for class knowledge.

Second, the repair shop could be used as a hiding place to avoid being hunted down by the Germinal Organization. The Germinal Organization had spies in all of the Six Nations, but this repair shop was one of the few locations that the Germinal Organization did not know. Even if the enemy really chased after them, even if the sky fell, there would be someone tall to hold it up. Conservatively speaking, Old Man Lu's combat strength was enough to beat up the current Hila. Although Old Man Lu looked like a sloppy old thug, in reality, he was hiding a strong combat strength. He was one of the few Grade D Supers on Planet Aquamarine. In the novice planets of Version 1.0, the strongest person was at most Grade C, which was enough to be considered a tyrant. Even in the galaxy, he could be considered a backbone.

There was a famous theory behind the Mechanic class that said, "If the endurance of a normal person is the limit of a machine, then more than ninety percent of inventions will be limited." "Only a strong individual can use stronger machines." As they grew, the restrictions on the use of machines became stricter. Some of the stronger machines could only be used by Mechanics, and the other four classes could not use them.

The Mechanic class did not always fight with huge guns and huge cannons while wearing mechanical suits. High-level Mechanics used different machines as the core of their battle tactics, and they could create many different battle modes, such as assault, control, assassination, defense, long-range, and so on. There were many possibilities for robot armies, Launchers with firepower coverage, mechanical suit warriors, Mechanical Pugilists with high-tech cold weapons in close combat, virtual illusions, fortress deployment, and even modifying themselves into mechanical bodies. There were many possibilities.

In the official information given by Galaxy, the introduction of Mechanics was as follows: "Proficient in using mechanical weapons in battle, with the ability to assemble at high speed, excellent all-rounder."

The most important term was' High Speed Assembly '. After learning [High Density Material Compression Technology] and [Elementary Spatial Technology], Mechanics could fold huge weapons into metal pieces the size of a finger and carry them around with them. When triggered in battle, they could instantly expand and return to their original state.

Energy was the energy reservoir of the Esper class, the attack power of the Pugilist class, the magic source of the Mage class, and the psychic energy reactor of the Psychic class. The energy of the Mechanic class was, of course, not just for decoration. When one's energy reached a certain level, it could replace the use of hands, lathes, and equipment, creating new machines from scratch at high speed in battle. As long as there was not a lack of raw materials, a Mechanic's weapons would be endless. Of course, the prerequisite was to learn [Instant Disassembly and Assembly] and some other class knowledge.

Because the inventory of the players was real weight, only the Mechanic class, the Mage class, and the extremely rare Space Esper class could achieve the effect of a Space Bag.

The third benefit was the most important. The repair shop was related to a hidden storyline, and they could obtain a few early blueprints of the Mechanic class.

Old Man Lu would leave the repair shop in the future and leave behind a password-protected box containing blueprints that he had studied for many years. He asked Lu Qian to pass it to her father, Lu Cheng. Lu Cheng was a rogue warlord, and Old Man Lu had always had a bad relationship with his son.

In Han Xiao's previous life, a Mechanic player had run dozens of complex missions before finally obtaining the password to open the box. After that, he had spent a lot of effort to gather the materials. After completing the creation, the rewards were immediate. His combat power soared, and he became the king of the PK field. His record was thirty-eight consecutive wins. Even when three players of the same level fought him together, they were still beaten.

Those blueprints were the early stage Mechanic class artifacts, and Han Xiao did not even need to do the complex missions.

He knew the password from the start!

The hidden storyline was a competitive mission. Although only one person could complete it, the other players would also know the password after completing the missions. Later on, someone posted a post on the forums, and that was how Han Xiao learned about it.

Old Man Lu left the password-protected box after the open beta, and Han Xiao took advantage of the fact that he was close to Old Man Lu.

For the sake of those artifacts, it was worth it!

"I'll tell you about the treatment of apprentices. The monthly salary is a thousand, and the meals and accommodation are included. There's an empty room on the second floor, and your normal job is to perform mechanical maintenance and complete customer orders. Is that okay?"

Lu Qian looked at Han Xiao anxiously. She had seen Han Xiao's capabilities and was worried that such a salary would anger him. However, she did not have any extra money.

"I can accept."

Lu Qian was overjoyed and immediately liked him.

The second floor was a full living room with a living room, bathroom, kitchen, and a few bedrooms.

Lu Qian brought Han Xiao to his bedroom. There was a wooden bed without a mattress, a wardrobe, a bookshelf, and a small workbench.

"This is your room." Lu Qian handed the key to the room to Han Xiao and enthusiastically helped him to clean the room.

A thousand was not even enough for a month's food. Lu Qian could not be more satisfied with Han Xiao. Where else could she find such good labor at such a low price? This kid is probably stupid. I have to treat him well and not let him run away.
